Suggest PCR error cutoff

Source: R/vtamR_fun.R
suggest_pcr_error_cutoff.Rd

Identify pairs of expected and unexpected ASVs in mock samples that differ by at most max_mismatch, and compute their read count ratios to help determine an appropriate pcr_error_var_prop threshold.

Usage

suggest_pcr_error_cutoff(
  read_count,
  mock_composition,
  vsearch_path = NULL,
  num_threads = 0,
  sep = ",",
  outfile = NULL,
  max_mismatch = 1,
  min_read_count = 10,
  quiet = TRUE,
  log_file = NULL
)

Arguments

read_count

Data frame or CSV file with the following variables: asv_id, sample, replicate, read_count, asv.

mock_composition

Data frame or CSV file with columns: sample, action (keep or tolerate), asv.

vsearch_path

Optional path to the vsearch executable. If NULL (default), resolved via getOption("vtamR.vsearch_path") or the PATH (see get_path).

num_threads

Positive integer specifying the number of CPU threads to use. If 0, all available CPUs are used.

sep

Field separator character used in input and output CSV files.

outfile

Character string specifying the output CSV file. If NULL, no file is written.

max_mismatch

Positive integer specifying the maximum number of mismatches allowed between ASVs to be compared.

min_read_count

Positive integer specifying the minimum read count threshold; occurrences below this value are ignored.

quiet

Logical. If TRUE, suppress informational messages and only show warnings or errors.

log_file

Character string specifying the path to the CSV log file. The path is resolved with the following priority:

  1. the log_file argument, if explicitly provided by the user;

  2. the vtamR.log_file option set with options(vtamR.log_file = ...), if set;

  3. "vtamR_log.csv" in the current working directory, used as a last resort if neither of the above is set.

To disable logging entirely, set log_file = NA.

Value

Data frame with the following columns: sample, expected_read_count, unexpected_read_count, pcr_error_var_prop, expected_asv_id, unexpected_asv_id, expected_asv, unexpected_asv.

Details

The suggested cutoff should be set above the maximum observed ratio (unexpected_read_count / expected_read_count) in the output table.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
suggest_pcr_error_cutoff(
  read_count = read_count_df,
  mock_composition = "data/mock_composition.csv",
  max_mismatch = 2,
  min_read_count = 5
)
} # }
